name: GitHub MCP repositories
measures: New public repositories tagged mcp-server, by month
about: MCP servers give AI models access to tools and data. GitHub's search API counts public repositories by topic and creation date. We store only those monthly counts, not repository data.
attribution: Counts derived from the GitHub search API.
limitations: A repo counts only if its owner added the tag and still has it, so earlier months can change.
It counts repos, not working servers: tutorials, duplicates and abandoned projects are included.
Forks and private repos are not counted, and neither are servers kept outside GitHub.
AI coding agents make repos cheaper to create, so growth may not mean more demand.
